# telnyx_messaging_profile_auto_response (Resource)

An auto-response setting on a messaging profile, which answers inbound messages containing given keywords (opt-in, opt-out or help) with a fixed reply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_messaging_profile_auto_response" "stop" {
  messaging_profile_id = telnyx_messaging_profile.support.id
  op                   = "stop"
  keywords             = ["STOP", "UNSUBSCRIBE"]
  country_code         = "US"
  resp_text            = "You are unsubscribed from Acme alerts. Reply START to resubscribe."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `country_code` (String) The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the senders this setting applies to, or `*` for all countries.
- `keywords` (Set of String) The keywords in an inbound message that trigger the response.
- `messaging_profile_id` (String) The messaging profile id.
- `op` (String) The opt-in state the keywords trigger: `start` (opt in), `stop` (opt out) or `info` (help). One of `info`, `start`, `stop`.

### Optional

- `resp_text` (String) The text sent in reply.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_messaging_profile_auto_response.stop <messaging_profile_id>/<id>
```
